const b = $json.body || $json || {};
return { json: {
  agent_id: b.agent_id || 'unknown-agent',
  user_id: b.user_id || 'anonymous',
  request: b.request || b.prompt || '',
  action: (b.action || 'generate'),
  tool: b.tool || null,
  tool_args: b.tool_args || {},
  confidence: (typeof b.confidence === 'number') ? b.confidence : 1,
  disclosed: b.disclosed === true,
  human_in_loop: b.human_in_loop === true,
  allowed_tools: Array.isArray(b.allowed_tools) ? b.allowed_tools : [],
  received_at: new Date().toISOString()
} };
